evidence: Our use of or failure to adopt advancements in information technology, such as artificial intelligence, may hinder or prevent us from achieving strategic objectives or otherwise harm our business.

reduced demand for office space, including as a result of changes in work habits, including remote or hybrid work schedules, or reductions in employee headcount due to artificial intelligence technologies
The rapid evolution and increased adoption of artificial intelligence technologies may also heighten our cybersecurity risks by making cyber-attacks more difficult to detect, contain, and mitigate.

Our use of or inability to safely and effectively adopt and deliver new technological capabilities and enhancements in line with strategic objectives, including artificial intelligence, may put us at a competitive disadvantage
ai_positioning.summary: FBRT adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, identifiant principalement des risques : menaces concurrentielles liées à l'adoption insuffisante, risques cybersécurité accrus, et impact négatif sur la demande immobilière (télétravail, réduction d'effectifs). Aucune stratégie offensive ou intégration proactive mentionnée.
